SELECT r.project_id,r.revision_id,r.artifact_id,r.kind,r.input_refs,r.audience,
    CASE WHEN r.kind=$2 THEN r.payload->>$3 END AS catalog_voice_kind,
    jsonb_build_object(
        $4,COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(e)) FROM artifact_dependencies e
            WHERE e.project_id=r.project_id AND e.consumer_id=r.revision_id),$5::jsonb),
        $6,COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(d.payload::jsonb
            ORDER BY (d.payload->>$7)::bigint)
            FROM dependency_revalidations d WHERE d.project_id=r.project_id AND d.subject_id=r.revision_id
            AND (d.acceptance_record_id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT $8 FROM revocations v
                WHERE v.project_id=d.project_id AND v.acceptance_record_id=d.acceptance_record_id))),
            $9::jsonb),
        $10,COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(l.input_id) FROM revalidation_privacy_links l
            WHERE l.project_id=r.project_id AND l.subject_id=r.revision_id),$11::jsonb),
        $12,COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(b)||jsonb_build_object(
            $13,a.purpose,
            $14,EXISTS(SELECT $15 FROM blob_access_revocations v
                WHERE v.project_id=b.project_id AND v.sha256=b.sha256),
            $16,EXISTS(SELECT $17 FROM evaluator_blob_classifications c
                WHERE c.project_id=b.project_id AND c.sha256=b.sha256)))
            FROM artifact_blobs a JOIN blobs b USING(project_id,storage_key)
            WHERE a.project_id=r.project_id AND a.revision_id=r.revision_id),$18::jsonb),
        $19,EXISTS(SELECT $20 FROM invalidations i WHERE i.project_id=r.project_id
            AND i.revision_id=r.revision_id AND i.category=$21),
        $22,COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
            $23,l.record_id,$24,l.record_kind)) FROM runtime_links l
            WHERE l.project_id=r.project_id AND l.revision_id=r.revision_id),$25::jsonb)
    ) AS access_graph
FROM artifact_revisions r WHERE r.revision_id=ANY($1)
INSERT INTO runtime_records VALUES($1,$2,$3,CAST($4 AS json),$5)

WITH refs AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM podgen_runtime_references(NEW.payload)),
 artifacts AS (
   INSERT INTO runtime_artifact_refs
   SELECT NEW.project_id,NEW.record_id,podgen_runtime_reference_uuid(reference->>$17),
     podgen_runtime_reference_uuid(reference->>$18),reference->>$19
   FROM refs WHERE reference_kind=$20 ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
 ), runtimes AS (
   INSERT INTO runtime_runtime_refs
   SELECT NEW.project_id,NEW.record_id,podgen_runtime_reference_uuid(reference->>$21),reference->>$22
   FROM refs WHERE reference_kind=$23 ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
 )
 INSERT INTO runtime_blob_refs
 SELECT NEW.project_id,NEW.record_id,reference->>$24,reference->>$25,
   podgen_runtime_reference_length(reference->$26),reference->>$27
 FROM refs WHERE reference_kind=$28 ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

WITH RECURSIVE tree(value) AS (
   SELECT podgen_runtime_reference_document(document)
   UNION ALL
   SELECT child.value FROM tree AS parent CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
     SELECT item.value FROM json_each(CASE
       WHEN json_typeof(parent.value) = $2
        AND podgen_runtime_reference_kind(parent.value) IS NULL THEN parent.value
       ELSE $3::json END) AS item
     UNION ALL
     SELECT item.value FROM json_array_elements(CASE
       WHEN json_typeof(parent.value) = $4 THEN parent.value
       ELSE $5::json END) AS item
   ) AS child
 )
 SELECT podgen_runtime_reference_kind(value), value
 FROM tree WHERE podgen_runtime_reference_kind(value) IS NOT NULL

WITH RECURSIVE runtime_reach(record_id) AS (
    SELECT unnest(CAST($1 AS uuid[]))
    UNION
    SELECT edge.target_record_id
    FROM runtime_runtime_refs edge JOIN runtime_reach parent ON edge.record_id=parent.record_id
    JOIN runtime_records owner ON owner.project_id=edge.project_id AND owner.record_id=edge.record_id
    WHERE edge.project_id=$2 AND owner.execution_input_set_id IS NULL
      AND NOT(edge.target_record_id=ANY(CAST($3 AS uuid[])))
)
SELECT r.project_id,r.record_id,r.record_kind,r.audience,r.execution_run_id,r.execution_input_set_id,
    COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        $4,a.artifact_id,$5,a.revision_id,$6,a.kind))
        FROM runtime_artifact_refs a WHERE a.project_id=r.project_id AND a.record_id=r.record_id),
        $7::jsonb) AS artifact_references,
    COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        $8,a.target_record_id,$9,a.record_kind))
        FROM runtime_runtime_refs a WHERE a.project_id=r.project_id AND a.record_id=r.record_id
          AND r.execution_input_set_id IS NULL),
        $10::jsonb) AS runtime_references,
    COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        $11,a.storage_key,$12,a.sha256,$13,a.byte_length,$14,a.media_type))
        FROM runtime_blob_refs a WHERE a.project_id=r.project_id AND a.record_id=r.record_id),
        $15::jsonb) AS blob_references
FROM runtime_records r JOIN runtime_reach n ON r.record_id=n.record_id
WHERE r.project_id=$2 AND NOT(r.record_id=ANY(CAST($3 AS uuid[])))

SELECT CASE WHEN json_typeof(value) = $2 THEN CASE
   WHEN ARRAY(SELECT key FROM json_object_keys(value) AS key ORDER BY key) = ARRAY[$3,$4,$5] THEN $6
   WHEN ARRAY(SELECT key FROM json_object_keys(value) AS key ORDER BY key) = ARRAY[$7,$8] THEN $9
   WHEN ARRAY(SELECT key FROM json_object_keys(value) AS key ORDER BY key) = ARRAY[$10,$11,$12,$13] THEN $14
 END END

WITH expansion AS (
 SELECT owner_versions FROM execution_input_expansions WHERE project_id=$1 AND set_id=$2
), freshness AS (
 SELECT count(*)>$6 AND bool_and(COALESCE(p.validity_version=owner.value::bigint,$7)) AS fresh
 FROM expansion CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(owner_versions) owner
 LEFT JOIN projects p ON p.project_id=owner.key::uuid
), conditions AS (
 SELECT r.*,CASE WHEN $3 THEN r.purpose ELSE $4 END AS check_purpose,
   m.role,
   a.revision_id AS artifact_found, a.artifact_id, a.kind AS artifact_kind,
   runtime.record_id AS runtime_found, runtime.record_kind AS runtime_kind,
   b.storage_key AS blob_found,b.sha256,b.byte_length,b.media_type,
   pub.publication_id AS publication_found,pub.config
 FROM execution_input_resources r
 LEFT JOIN project_members m ON m.project_id=r.owner_project_id AND m.actor_id=$5
 LEFT JOIN artifact_revisions a ON r.resource_kind=$8
   AND a.project_id=r.owner_project_id AND a.revision_id=CASE WHEN r.resource_kind=$9 THEN r.identity::uuid END
 LEFT JOIN runtime_records runtime ON r.resource_kind=$10
   AND runtime.project_id=r.owner_project_id AND runtime.record_id=CASE WHEN r.resource_kind=$11 THEN r.identity::uuid END
 LEFT JOIN blobs b ON r.resource_kind=$12
   AND b.project_id=r.owner_project_id AND b.storage_key=r.identity
 LEFT JOIN catalog_publications pub ON r.resource_kind=$13
   AND pub.project_id=r.owner_project_id AND pub.publication_id=CASE WHEN r.resource_kind=$14 THEN r.identity::uuid END
 WHERE r.project_id=$1 AND r.set_id=$2 AND ($3 OR r.purpose=$4)
)
SELECT (SELECT fresh FROM freshness) AS fresh,
 NOT EXISTS(SELECT $15 FROM conditions c WHERE CASE c.resource_kind
 WHEN $16 THEN c.role IS NULL OR (c.identity=$17 AND (c.check_purpose<>$18 OR c.role NOT IN ($19,$20,$21)))
 WHEN $22 THEN c.artifact_found IS NULL
   OR c.artifact_id::text IS DISTINCT FROM c.binding->>$23
   OR c.artifact_kind IS DISTINCT FROM c.binding->>$24
   OR EXISTS(SELECT $25 FROM invalidations i WHERE i.project_id=c.owner_project_id
      AND i.revision_id=c.artifact_found AND i.category=$26)
 WHEN $27 THEN c.runtime_found IS NULL OR c.runtime_kind IS DISTINCT FROM c.binding->>$28
   OR EXISTS(SELECT $29 FROM execution_record_withdrawals w WHERE w.project_id=c.owner_project_id AND w.record_id=c.runtime_found)
 WHEN $30 THEN c.blob_found IS NULL OR c.sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM c.binding->>$31
   OR c.byte_length IS DISTINCT FROM (c.binding->>$32)::bigint
   OR c.media_type IS DISTINCT FROM c.binding->>$33
   OR EXISTS(SELECT $34 FROM blob_access_revocations v WHERE v.project_id=c.owner_project_id
      AND v.sha256=c.binding->>$35)
   OR (c.read_required AND EXISTS(SELECT $36 FROM evaluator_protected_hashes e
      WHERE e.project_id=c.owner_project_id AND e.sha256=c.binding->>$37)
      AND (c.check_purpose<>$38 OR c.role IS NULL OR c.role NOT IN ($39,$40,$41)))
 WHEN $42 THEN c.publication_found IS NULL
   OR NOT(c.config->$43 ? (c.binding->>$44))
   OR EXISTS(SELECT $45 FROM catalog_revocations v WHERE v.publication_id=c.publication_found)
 ELSE $46 END) AS allowed

WITH expansion AS (
 SELECT owner_versions FROM execution_input_expansions WHERE project_id=$1 AND set_id=$2
), freshness AS (
 SELECT count(*)>$6 AND bool_and(COALESCE(p.validity_version=owner.value::bigint,$7)) AS fresh
 FROM expansion CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(owner_versions) owner
 LEFT JOIN projects p ON p.project_id=owner.key::uuid
), conditions AS (
 SELECT r.*,CASE WHEN $3 THEN r.purpose ELSE $4 END AS check_purpose,
   m.role,
   a.revision_id AS artifact_found, a.artifact_id, a.kind AS artifact_kind,
   runtime.record_id AS runtime_found, runtime.record_kind AS runtime_kind,
   b.storage_key AS blob_found,b.sha256,b.byte_length,b.media_type,
   pub.publication_id AS publication_found,pub.config
 FROM execution_input_resources r
 LEFT JOIN project_members m ON m.project_id=r.owner_project_id AND m.actor_id=$5
 LEFT JOIN artifact_revisions a ON r.resource_kind=$8
   AND a.project_id=r.owner_project_id AND a.revision_id=CASE WHEN r.resource_kind=$9 THEN r.identity::uuid END
 LEFT JOIN runtime_records runtime ON r.resource_kind=$10
   AND runtime.project_id=r.owner_project_id AND runtime.record_id=CASE WHEN r.resource_kind=$11 THEN r.identity::uuid END
 LEFT JOIN blobs b ON r.resource_kind=$12
   AND b.project_id=r.owner_project_id AND b.storage_key=r.identity
 LEFT JOIN catalog_publications pub ON r.resource_kind=$13
   AND pub.project_id=r.owner_project_id AND pub.publication_id=CASE WHEN r.resource_kind=$14 THEN r.identity::uuid END
 WHERE r.project_id=$1 AND r.set_id=$2 AND ($3 OR r.purpose=$4)
)
SELECT (SELECT fresh FROM freshness) AS fresh,
 NOT EXISTS(SELECT $15 FROM conditions c WHERE CASE c.resource_kind
 WHEN $16 THEN c.role IS NULL OR (c.identity=$17 AND (c.check_purpose<>$18 OR c.role NOT IN ($19,$20,$21)))
 WHEN $22 THEN c.artifact_found IS NULL
   OR c.artifact_id::text IS DISTINCT FROM c.binding->>$23
   OR c.artifact_kind IS DISTINCT FROM c.binding->>$24
   OR EXISTS(SELECT $25 FROM invalidations i WHERE i.project_id=c.owner_project_id
      AND i.revision_id=c.artifact_found AND i.category=$26)
 WHEN $27 THEN c.runtime_found IS NULL OR c.runtime_kind IS DISTINCT FROM c.binding->>$28
   OR EXISTS(SELECT $29 FROM execution_record_withdrawals w WHERE w.project_id=c.owner_project_id AND w.record_id=c.runtime_found)
 WHEN $30 THEN c.blob_found IS NULL OR c.sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM c.binding->>$31
   OR c.byte_length IS DISTINCT FROM (c.binding->>$32)::bigint
   OR c.media_type IS DISTINCT FROM c.binding->>$33
   OR EXISTS(SELECT $34 FROM blob_access_revocations v WHERE v.project_id=c.owner_project_id

   OR (c.read_required AND EXISTS(SELECT $36 FROM evaluator_protected_hashes e
      WHERE e.project_id=c.owner_project_id AND e.sha256=c.binding->>$37)
      AND (c.check_purpose<>$38 OR c.role IS NULL OR c.role NOT IN ($39,$40,$41)))
 WHEN $42 THEN c.publication_found IS NULL
   OR NOT(c.config->$43 ? (c.binding->>$44))
   OR EXISTS(SELECT $45 FROM catalog_revocations v WHERE v.publication_id=c.publication_found)

            WHERE l.project_id=r.project_id AND l.subject_id=r.revision_id),'[]'::jsonb),
        'blobs',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(b)||jsonb_build_object(

                WHERE v.project_id=b.project_id AND v.sha256=b.sha256),

            WHERE a.project_id=r.project_id AND a.revision_id=r.revision_id),'[]'::jsonb),

WITH permitted AS (SELECT m.source_id,c.start_offset,c.end_offset,c.language,c.lexical,c.exact_terms,c.phrase_text,c.embedding FROM source_search_memberships m JOIN source_search_documents d ON d.project_id=m.project_id AND d.document_key=m.document_key JOIN source_search_document_chunks c ON c.project_id=d.project_id AND c.document_key=d.document_key WHERE m.project_id=%(p)s AND m.shared_input_record_id=%(r)s AND m.profile_sha256=%(h)s AND m.source_id=ANY(%(scope)s) AND d.completed) SELECT source_id,start_offset,end_offset,1-(embedding <=> CAST(%(vector)s AS vector)) AS score FROM permitted ORDER BY embedding <=> CAST(%(vector)s AS vector),source_id,start_offset LIMIT %(limit)s

WITH permitted AS (SELECT m.source_id,c.start_offset,c.end_offset,c.language,c.lexical,c.exact_terms,c.phrase_text,c.embedding FROM source_search_memberships m JOIN source_search_documents d ON d.project_id=m.project_id AND d.document_key=m.document_key JOIN source_search_document_chunks c ON c.project_id=d.project_id AND c.document_key=d.document_key WHERE m.project_id=%(p)s AND m.shared_input_record_id=%(r)s AND m.profile_sha256=%(h)s AND m.source_id=ANY(%(scope)s) AND d.completed) SELECT source_id,start_offset,end_offset,ts_rank_cd(lexical,websearch_to_tsquery(CASE language WHEN 'en' THEN 'english'::regconfig WHEN 'ru' THEN 'russian'::regconfig ELSE 'simple'::regconfig END,%(lexical_query)s)) AS score FROM permitted WHERE lexical @@ websearch_to_tsquery(CASE language WHEN 'en' THEN 'english'::regconfig WHEN 'ru' THEN 'russian'::regconfig ELSE 'simple'::regconfig END,%(lexical_query)s) ORDER BY score DESC,source_id,start_offset LIMIT %(limit)s

WITH permitted AS (SELECT m.source_id,c.start_offset,c.end_offset,c.language,c.lexical,c.exact_terms,c.phrase_text,c.embedding FROM source_search_memberships m JOIN source_search_documents d ON d.project_id=m.project_id AND d.document_key=m.document_key JOIN source_search_document_chunks c ON c.project_id=d.project_id AND c.document_key=d.document_key WHERE m.project_id=%(p)s AND m.shared_input_record_id=%(r)s AND m.profile_sha256=%(h)s AND m.source_id=ANY(%(scope)s) AND d.completed) SELECT source_id,start_offset,end_offset,((strpos(' '||phrase_text||' ',%(phrase)s)>0)::int + (SELECT count(*)::float FROM unnest(CAST(%(entities)s AS text[])) AS e(term) WHERE e.term=ANY(exact_terms))/GREATEST(cardinality(CAST(%(entities)s AS text[])),1)) AS score FROM permitted WHERE strpos(' '||phrase_text||' ',%(phrase)s)>0 OR exact_terms && CAST(%(entities)s AS text[]) ORDER BY score DESC,source_id,start_offset LIMIT %(limit)s
